subject.title: fix(ui): turn large pasted text into compact composer attachments

question: Should the Control UI composer convert plain-text pastes over 1000 characters into `text/plain` attachment cards by default?
rationale: The implementation is focused, but the threshold changes existing composer paste behavior and automation should not choose that default UX policy for maintainers.

options.title: Accept the 1000-character default
options.body: Proceed with this attachment-card behavior after exact-head CI and normal maintainer review pass.

options.title: Revise the threshold or affordance
options.body: Ask for a different cutoff, label, or restore interaction while keeping the existing attachment send path.

options.title: Decline default conversion
options.body: Keep long plain-text paste as textarea input unless users explicitly attach a file.

recommendation.title: Accept the 1000-character default
recommendation.body: Proceed with this attachment-card behavior after exact-head CI and normal maintainer review pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest history-backed owner for the adjacent paste attachment behavior and recent composer UX decisions.
